Adults and teens (ages 12-17)

You deserve to feel better. At Neuro Wellness Spa, our expertly trained psychiatrists and thoughtfully designed centers provide compassionate, personalized treatment for a wide range of mental health conditions, helping you achieve meaningful, lasting change.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
A pattern of using substances like drugs or alcohol often leads to harmful consequences to physical and mental health, work, or relationships.
ADHD is characterized by difficulty focusing, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that interferes with daily life.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
Between hormonal changes, the psychological adjustment to motherhood, and exhaustion, depression affects approximately 1 in 8 new mothers.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Sometimes stress can come on quickly and feel paralyzing. Panic attacks are sudden, intense, can happen unexpectedly, and affect daily functioning.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Difficulty falling or staying asleep leads not only to fatigue throughout the day, but often irritability and trouble focusing.
There are many causes for trouble with memory, thinking, or decision-making. For those with impairment, it interferes with everyday life or work.
For some, cognitive impairment is a progressive decline over time, and can affect independence and quality of life.
A condition marked by unstable moods, relationships, and self-image, often with intense emotional reactions.
A neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication, social interaction, and behavior patterns in varying degrees.
When pain lasts for months or longer, it takes a toll on a whole person, affecting not just physical functioning but mood as well.
Widespread pain, fatigue, and sleep issues aren’t always easy to explain. Those with fibromyalgia may also be unusually sensitive to touch and stress.
Everyone has bouts of exhaustion, but when it is not easily explained, doesn’t improve with rest, and limits your activities or mental clarity, it is considered chronic fatigue.
Although many people are concerned about health, weight, or appearance, those with eating disorders become fixated on weight loss, body shape, and controlling their food intake.

Our compassionate team at Neuro Wellness Spa works with you to determine the specialized mental health treatment that will work best for you. We are here with you every step of the way on your journey.

Our Torrance psychiatrists offer personalized mental health evaluations and treatment plans for anxiety, depression, trauma, and related conditions. We offer flexible scheduling, integrated therapy and psychiatry, and a supportive, outcome-focused approach.

Our team provides psychiatric care designed to support teens facing challenges like anxiety, depression, ADHD, and mood disorders. We take a compassionate, family-informed approach and offer both in-person and virtual care options.

Therapy sessions are available for clients seeking support with anxiety, depression, trauma, and other emotional challenges. We offer personalized care, flexible scheduling, and a supportive, outcome-focused approach through talk therapy and evidence-based methods.

TMS is an FDA-cleared, non-invasive treatment for depression and other mental health conditions. Our Torrance location offers TMS therapy, which is ideal for those who haven’t found relief for depression and related mood disorders through traditional treatments.

mainEntity.name: What mental health services are available at the North Torrance location?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Neuro Wellness Spa, our North Torrance location provides a full spectrum of mental health services including in-person and virtual psychiatry, medication management, adolescent psychiatry, addiction psychiatry, psychotherapy (such as talk therapy, CBT, DBT, and addiction counseling), as well as advanced neuromodulation treatments like TMS Therapy.

mainEntity.name: Is care at the North Torrance location available for adults and adolescents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our North Torrance location offers tailored adolescent psychiatry programs for teens ages 12-17 in addition to our adult-focused programs. The developing brain works a lot differently than that of a mature adult.- It is maturing and evolving. Our teen programs are designed to address the unique physical and social needs of adolescents, not just modify an adult program.

mainEntity.name: How can I schedule an appointment at Neuro Wellness Spa in North Torrance?

acceptedAnswer.text: To schedule an appointment with a psychiatrist at our North Torrance location, give us a call at (877) 847-3984. Our admissions team will discuss your needs and schedule you for an initial consultation with our experts.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer medication management at Neuro Wellness Spa in North Torrance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes – medication management is provided at our North Torrance location when it’s required as part of your personalized mental health treatment plan.

mainEntity.name: Are in-person sessions available in North Torrance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both in-person and online psychiatric sessions are available at our North Torrance location. Some services (like TMS) are only available in-person.

mainEntity.name: What insurance plans are accepted at the North Torrance office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neuro Wellness Spa accepts all major commercial insurance, including Aetna, Anthem, Blue Shield, Optum, MHN/Healthnet, Tricare, Cigna, Magellan, Beacon, and more. We’re experts at helping our patients navigate the often-confusion world of insurance coverage. Give us a call today and we’ll help you sort out what is covered and develop a treatment plan that works for you and your insurance.

mainEntity.name: Can I receive both talk therapy and medication support at the North Torrance location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both talk therapy and medication management are available at our North Torrance location.
